support_claim: Unresolved-preservation propositions explicitly preserve registry identity as undetermined, and no proposition establishes that billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 denote the same or distinct legal counterparties.

propositions.proposition: Sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics", while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Describes naming variants across systems; does not establish which registry entity is the legal counterparty for either referent.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC".
propositions.relevance: Introduces an additional live registry candidate that may be the contracting party; does not by itself establish that the billing referent and the contract referent are distinct.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
propositions.relevance: The packet explicitly preserves identity between the candidate referents as undetermined at the registry level.

propositions.proposition: The commercial notes instruct to treat the registry link as unresolved.
propositions.relevance: Direct instruction not to close identity; multiple live candidates remain.

propositions.proposition: Billing records list billed_name as "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent (billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc.) to a billed name in source data.

propositions.proposition: Contract MSA-NBA-2021 lists the counterparty as "Northbridge Analytics, Inc."
propositions.relevance: Identifies the counterparty name associated with the right referent (contract:MSA-NBA-2021); name compatibility alone does not establish registry identity.
